subject: english
question:
Replace the bracketed word with one of the given options, which suitably replaces the word without changing the meaning of the sentence:

In the age of technology, smartphones have become (ubiquitous), infiltrating every aspect of our lives, from communication and work to entertainment and even our daily routines.
solution:
The correct answer is: **omnipresent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ubiquitous"** means something that is present, appearing, or found everywhere. (हर जगह मौजूद)

 
 
• **Example: **Wireless internet has become ubiquitous in urban areas.
 
 
 
• **"Omnipresent" **refers to something that is present everywhere at the same time, much like 'ubiquitous'. (सर्वव्यापी)
 
 
• **Example: **In modern society, social media seems to be omnipresent.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. omnipresent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Obsolete **(अप्रचलित): No longer produced or used; out of date.

 
 
• **Example:** The typewriter has become obsolete in the age of computers.
 
 
 
• **Irreplicable **(अप्रतिलिप्य): Impossible to duplicate or reproduce.
 
 
• **Example: **Her unique style of painting is irreplicable.
 
 
 
• **Candid** (खुला): Truthful and straightforward; frank.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave a candid interview about her career.
